title: Chow groups of Chow varieties
summary: Let $C_{p,d}(\mathbb{P}^n)$ be the Chow variety of effective algebraic $p$-cycles of degree $d$ in complex projective $n$-space $\mathbb{P}^n$. In this paper, we compute the rational Chow groups $\mathrm{Ch}_q(C_{p,d}(\mathbb{P}^n))_\mathbb{Q}$ for $0 \le q \le d$. We show that these Chow groups are isomorphic to the corresponding rational singular homology groups $H_{2q}(C_{p,d}(\mathbb{P}^n), \mathbb{Q})$ in this range, a result that was previously known.
